question: The Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India has designed an education portal named:
solution:
The correct answer is__** SAKSHAT.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SAKSHAT** is an education portal designed by the **Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD)**, Government of India.
 
• It serves as a one-stop education portal offering resources for students, teachers, and learners across all educational levels.
 
• The portal provides various digital learning tools, including **e-books, study material, and online courses**.
 
• SAKSHAT is aimed at promoting **online education and e-learning** to ensure wider access to quality educational content.
 
• It also acts as a platform for disseminating information about government education policies and initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Educational Portals**:

 
 
• **NIOS** (National Institute of Open Schooling): An autonomous institution under the Ministry of Education offering open schooling at secondary and senior secondary levels.
 
• **NCERT** (National Council of Educational Research and Training): Provides educational resources, curriculum development, and textbook publications for schools across India.
 
• **EDUCATION**: A general term, not a specific portal, referring to various platforms designed for the promotion of education in India.
 
 
 
• **SAKSHAT Portal Features**:
 
 
• Offers a range of **multimedia content** for learners at all levels, including video tutorials and interactive learning modules.
 
• Provides access to **virtual labs** for science education, helping students perform experiments online.
 
• Integrates with other government educational initiatives like **SWAYAM** (Study Webs of Active Learning for Young Aspiring Minds), which provides MOOCs (Massive Open Online Courses).
 
 
 
• **Objectives of SAKSHAT**:
 
 
• To provide quality education and reduce the digital divide in India.
 
• To ensure that learners in remote areas have access to the same educational resources as those in urban centers.
